senses.sense_definition: A humble prayer or plea addressed to a deity.

examples.text: The villagers knelt in fervent <w>supplication</w>, asking for rain to save their crops.
Her daily routine began with quiet moments of prayer and <w>supplication</w>.

senses.sense_definition: An earnest, humble request or petition made to someone in authority.

examples.text: The prisoner made a desperate <w>supplication</w> for mercy before the judge.
He approached the committee in an attitude of humble <w>supplication</w>.

senses.sense_definition: In Islam, an informal or personal prayer (dua) made to ask God for blessings or forgiveness.

examples.text: After completing the formal prayers, he raised his hands in silent <w>supplication</w>.
Many believers recite specific words of <w>supplication</w> before traveling or eating.

senses.sense_definition: In ancient Rome, a solemn religious thanksgiving or day of prayer decreed in honor of the gods, usually following a military victory.

examples.text: The Roman senate decreed a public <w>supplication</w> to celebrate the general's triumph.
Citizens gathered in the temples during the days of <w>supplication</w> across the capital.

traits.comment: Historical term for a specific Roman religious observance

senses.sense_definition: At Oxford University, the formal procedure by which a candidate requests permission to receive a doctoral degree after their thesis is approved.

examples.text: Once her examiners signed the report, she completed her formal <w>supplication</w> for the doctorate.
The registrar confirmed that his <w>supplication</w> had been approved ahead of the graduation ceremony.
